newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock sells three floors at Grandtech.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock sells three floors at Grandtech.

text.p: Wheelock Properties Ltd, a unit of Wheelock and Co Ltd, said it had sold three floors at its 22-storey Grandtech Centre warehouse complex development in Shatin, in the New Territories.

"We have sold three floors of the building so far and there is another buyer negotiating to buy another whole floor," Wheelock Properties managing director Ray Tse said in prepared speech which he gave at a tour of the complex on Tuesday.
A spokewoman from Wheelock said the three floors had been sold at price ranging from HK$1,200 to HK$1,500 per square foot.
The size of the units on offer at the Grandtech Centre ranges from over 1,000 square feet per unit to the whole floor of about 50,000 to 60,000 square feet.
